title: Finite Core, Observer, and Server Release Closure
summary: A release candidate is publishable only after all component, portable package, compatibility, and safety gates pass on the exact release inputs.
acceptanceBoundary: Run gates against the exact source revision and package inputs.
Keep Core, Observer, Server, and portable package outcomes distinct.
Any skipped, incomplete, or stale gate blocks qualification.
Synthetic fixtures do not qualify an installed deployment or real project corpus.
deferredClaims: Cross-host synchronization or shared publication authority.
Large-corpus throughput and sustained memory behavior.
Installer upgrade and rollback compatibility until exercised on disposable state.
stopRule: Do not describe a release as qualified while any required gate is missing or failing.
